name: arcade
description: Ask for what you want — your agent works across every connected app.
long_description: Turn Claude into a connected-app operator. Ask in plain English for email, calendar, issues, chat, or docs — Arcade finds and runs the right tool across every app you've signed into. Sign in once in the browser — without ever handing your agent a key. Requires Node.js (uses a pinned mcp-remote proxy to bridge Claude Desktop to the hosted gateway at https://api.bosslevel.dev/mcp/all-optimized).

tools.name: Arcade_SelectTools
tools.description: Find the right tool for a task, with its input schema included

tools.name: Arcade_UseTool
tools.description: Run a tool found by Arcade_SelectTools

tools.name: Arcade_RetrieveResult
tools.description: Read more of a truncated Arcade result by result_id (path or search)

tools.name: Arcade_Apps
tools.description: See, disconnect, or fix the connection for your connected apps

tools.name: Arcade_Project
tools.description: View or change your org, project, and gateway
